hypothesis: GRPO's self-reward gave no coverage gradient (all the model's drafts miss the same unknown). GAD's reward instead comes from a discriminator trained to tell Sonnet gold sets from the model's drafts — grounded in the TEACHER, whose sets contain the missing unknown — so in principle it could reward teacher-like coverage.
technique: An embedding-MLP discriminator (MiniLM set-embedding, val AUC 0.629) scores each draft by teacher-likeness; that score is the reward in the same KL-anchored group-relative policy gradient as exp058 (warm-start v2a_e1, beta_kl=1.0), epoch 1.
result: Scored 0.355 on the full-30 gate (0 win / 3 tie / 26 loss) — a regression below the 0.409 base; coverage stayed 3 and specificity fell 4->3. As two pre-registered diagnostics predicted, the teacher/student signal a discriminator climbs is STYLE (AUC 0.76) not content (0.62), so GAD pushed toward Sonnet's phrasing (which SFT already gave) and the style-chase cost specificity. Coverage is not a separable axis. Discarded.
label: adapter_gad_e1
